title: Save 30% Banner with Cafe Portrait
whatItIs: A wide banner with a navy top band carrying giant white light-weight 'Save 30%' and a small 'with payno', where a smiling man in a navy shirt with a phone rises from a cafe photo below into the band, overlapping the type.
whatItMeans: The person breaking into the headline band links the offer and the photo, and navy clothing keeps it on brand.
techniques: Subject overlapping a solid headline band
Small brand sign-off under the headline
Cafe photo as the lower half

vocabulary.definition: A subject extending from a photo into a solid colour band.
Big numbers set in a thin typeface weight.
A small brand mention closing a headline.
